title: Puget Sound Navy Museum

services.name: Schedule Tour
services.desc: The Puget Sound Navy Museum is a self-guided museum experience. We do encourage groups of 10+ visitors to notify the museum prior to their visit to ensure a quality museum experience. Museum programs offer a fun AND educational addition to your daily curriculum. The museum features two floors of interesting, hands-on, and interactive exhibits about the history and mission of the men and women that make up our local Navy community. Your students will explore concepts in history, science, engineering, technology, literacy, and more within the walls of PSNM! blurb: The Puget Sound Navy Museum is open to the public! We tell the story of the U.S. Navy in the Pacific Northwest. Our current operating hours are 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Monday and Wednesday - Sunday. We are closed on Tuesdays.
